summary.text: Erin Brady is a Democratic state representative from the Chittenden-2 District who has served in the Vermont House of Representatives since January 2021 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Erin Brady earned a bachelor's degree in political science from Colorado College in 2000 and a master's degree from Harvard University in 2006.
Brady's career experience includes working as a social studies teacher at Colchester High School and as an adjunct instructor at Saint Michael's College.
In the 2023-2024 session, Brady served on the House Education Committee.
